sources.scope: Explicitly publishes Standard $0.50/$2.50 and Fast (default) $3/$15 per million input/output tokens.

assumptions: Subscription-channel Anthropic and OpenAI cards are API-equivalent snapshot valuations; subscription credits, discounts, and invoices are not represented.
OpenRouter model IDs are cross-checked against the local catalog capture; its per-token USD values are converted to per-million-token decimal strings without floating-point arithmetic.

Anthropic Claude Opus 4.8 local spelling claude-opus-4-8 is an explicit normalized model identifier; its rates are cross-checked against the official Anthropic Claude Opus 4.8 row and OpenRouter catalog alias claude-opus-4.8.
grok-4.5-build and grok-4.6-build are exact local aliases valued from their corresponding Grok API/OpenRouter models; they are derived, standard-context subscription cards only.

Composer local-transcript counters are reconstructed estimates (approximately four characters per token in the adapter), while Composer 2.5 prices are published model-token equivalents. Fast is the default variant.
A provider-reported and derived card may coexist for one exact non-quality key because measurement quality is part of RateKey; this is intentional for merge behavior.
Claude local subscription records use service_tier=standard; explicit standard-tier cards are separate from the API/default cards and preserve that source dimension.

Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 use the official standard API rows ($5/$25 and $3/$15, respectively) with the documented 1.25x/2x cache-write and 0.1x cache-read multipliers; OpenRouter exact model entries cross-check those values.
excluded_coverage: Generic gpt-5.6, codex-auto-review, and unknown/prefix/wildcard model IDs are omitted and remain unpriced.
OpenAI models other than the exact gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.5, and gpt-5.4 cards are omitted.
Unsupported OpenAI cache-write charges, Anthropic unknown-TTL cache writes, and xAI long-context build aliases remain unpriced.
Anthropic model IDs outside the explicit snapshot list, including retired/provider-specific deployments, remain unpriced.
Cursor cloud-agent and third-party billing channels are omitted; only exact Composer 2.5 local-transcript standard/fast cards are included.
No discounts, credits, taxes, contracts, platform fees, tool charges, or historical spend are represented.
